Printed edition: Oeuvres complètes de Shakspeare, Paris : Ladvocat, 1821, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/oeuvrescomplte1821shak1. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 60%, 73%, 80% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of William Shakespeare, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
